data.name: Mujtahidun
data.gender_notes: Mujtahidun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is deeply knowledgeable and qualified to issue fatwas and make independent judgments in Islamic law. The name Mujtahidun carries the meaning “Scholar, Jurist” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mujtahidun usually hope their child will grow to embody scholar, jurist and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A seeker of truth and knowledge, committed to understanding and applying God's law in their daily life
data.etymology: Mujtahidun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Scholar, Jurist.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujtahidun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مجتهدون
in_arabic.meaning: المجتهدون هم الذين يبذلون جهدهم في فهم الدين و التفسير
in_arabic.long_meaning: المجتهدون هم الذين يبذلون جهدهم في فهم الدين و التفسير، و هم الذين يفتون في الدين بالاستنباط و الاستدلال، و هم من أهل العلم و الفقه، و يشترط فيهم أن يكونوا عادلين و ذكيين و متبحرين في علوم الدين.

in_urdu.name: مجتہدون
in_urdu.meaning: مجتہدون وہ لوگ ہیں جو دین کو سمجھنے اور تفسير کرنے کی کوشش کرتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: مجتہدون وہ لوگ ہیں جو دین کو سمجھنے اور تفسير کرنے کی کوشش کرتے ہیں، اور وہ لوگ ہیں جو دین میں اپنی رائے اور استنباط کے ذریعے فتویٰ دیتے ہیں، اور وہ علماء اور فقہاء کے صف میں شمار ہوتے ہیں، اور ان میں انصاف، ذہانت اور دینی علوم میں مہارت کا شرط لازم ہے.

in_hindi.name: मुजतहिदुन
in_hindi.meaning: मुजतहिदुन वे लोग हैं जो धर्म को समझने और व्याख्या करने का प्रयास करते हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुजतहिदुन वे लोग हैं जो धर्म को समझने और व्याख्या करने का प्रयास करते हैं, और वे लोग हैं जो धर्म में अपने विचार और तर्क के माध्यम से फतवा देते हैं, और वे उलेमा और फुकहा के पंक्ति में गिने जाते हैं, और उनमें न्याय, बुद्धिमत्ता और दैविक विज्ञान में प्रवीणता की शर्त आवश्यक है.

in_pashto.name: مجتهدون
in_pashto.meaning: مجتهدون هغه کسان دي چي د دين د پوهې او تفسير لپاره هڅه کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مجتهدون هغه کسان دي چي د دين د پوهې او تفسير لپاره هڅه کوي، او هغه کسان دي چي د دين په اړه د خپل نظر او استنباط له لارې فتوا ورکوي، او دوی د علماء او فقها په کتار کې شمیرل کیږي، او په هغوی کې د انصاف، هوښيارۍ او ديني علومو په مهارت شرط دی.

in_english.name: Mujtahidun
in_english.meaning: Mujtahidun are those who strive to understand and interpret the religion
in_english.long_meaning: Mujtahidun are those who strive to understand and interpret the religion, and they are the ones who give fatwa in the religion through their own reasoning and deduction, and they are counted among the scholars and jurists, and they are required to be just, intelligent, and proficient in the sciences of religion, derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ه-د' which means 'to strive' or 'to exert effort', reflecting their diligent efforts in seeking knowledge and understanding of Islamic law and theology.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Mujtahidun" is held in high esteem within the Islamic community, as it represents a scholar who has spent years studying Islamic law, firmly rooted in its teachings, and has gained the ability to make independent judgments based on their interpretation of Islamic texts. Mujtahidun are trusted advisors for the Muslim community, and their religious rules and guidelines are followed by many as a means to live their daily lives in accordance with Islamic values. They have the ability to shape the cultural and religious landscape of their communities, as their teachings and rulings help guide the behavior and beliefs of their followers.
data.spiritual_significance: The title "Mujtahidun" is a symbol of spiritual dedication and commitment to Islamic scholarship. It signifies a deep understanding and connection to the teachings of Islam, as well as a pursuit of knowledge for the sake of Allah (swt). The title implies a certain level of spiritual discipline, as the study and interpretation of Islamic law requires an immense amount of time, dedication, and focus. The spiritual significance of the title extends beyond the individual, as the knowledge and rulings of a Mujtahidun benefit the broader Muslim community. By following their teachings and guidance, Muslims can strive to live their daily lives in accordance with Islamic values, thereby deepening their spiritual connection to Allah (swt).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Scholar, Jurist" symbolizes One who is deeply knowledgeable and qualified to issue fatwas and make independent judgments in Islamic law. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mujtahidun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of scholar, jurist.
